products.name: Country Sourdough
products.description: A crackly crust and open crumb for everyday toast and sandwiches.
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, water, wheat sourdough starter, salt.

products.name: Whole Wheat Sourdough
products.description: 70% whole-wheat and 30% white wheat flour; a fuller flavor and closer crumb.
products.ingredients: Whole-wheat flour, white wheat flour, water, wheat sourdough starter, salt.

products.name: Seeded Rye
products.description: 60% rye and 40% wheat flour with sunflower and sesame seeds; a naturally denser loaf.
products.ingredients: Rye flour, wheat flour, water, wheat sourdough starter, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, salt.

products.name: Olive & Rosemary Sourdough
products.description: Black olives and rosemary folded into the country dough.
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, water, wheat sourdough starter, black olives, rosemary, salt.

products.name: Zaatar & Sesame Sourdough
products.description: A savory loaf with zaatar, sumac, and a sesame crust.
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, water, wheat sourdough starter, zaatar herbs, sumac, sesame seeds, salt.

products.name: Walnut & Cranberry Sourdough
products.description: Walnuts and dried cranberries for a gently sweet, nutty loaf.
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, water, wheat sourdough starter, walnuts, dried cranberries, salt.

policies.business: Cedar Crumb brings slow-fermented, small-batch bread to the everyday table. Good bread. Time well spent.
policies.ordering: Prices are per loaf in USD; baked weights are approximate. Pickup inquiries require at least 24 hours of notice and staff confirmation. Requests for more than 30 loaves, bread boxes, or wholesale arrangements require a staff quote. Save customer contact details only with consent.
policies.availability: Flavored loaves rotate by baking day. Staff confirms availability and pickup arrangements.
policies.allergens: All loaves contain gluten. The kitchen handles wheat, rye, sesame, walnuts, other nuts, milk, and eggs. Cross-contact is possible; allergen-free preparation cannot be guaranteed.
policies.delivery: Pickup inquiries are supported. Delivery coverage and fees require staff confirmation.
policies.storage: Wrap bread in a clean cloth or paper at room temperature for up to two days; slice and freeze for longer storage.
policies.fermentation: Sourdough batches generally ferment for 24-36 hours.
